registered: 2026-11-15, committed and pushed before any result was computed
hypothesis: The SPX volatility risk premium (VIX above subsequent realized vol on 86% of days 1990-2026) can be harvested with a defined-risk, short-dated put credit spread whose modelled credit exceeds payouts plus costs.
pricing_assumption: No historical option prices exist in the repo. Spreads are priced with Black-Scholes, sigma = VIX/100 for both strikes, r = 0, q = 0, T = 30/365. VIX is 30-day ATM-weighted implied vol; real OTM puts trade at higher implied vol (skew), so modelled credits are expected to be LOWER than real credits for the short leg and the long leg alike; net effect on the spread is not assumed. Results are a model estimate, not a fill record.

rules.schedule: Non-overlapping cycles: enter at the close of trading day i, expire at the close of day i+21 (trading days), next entry at that expiry close.
rules.short_strike: K1 = S * exp(-1.0 * sigma * sqrt(T)) (about one standard deviation below spot).
rules.long_strike: K2 = K1 - 0.5 * S * sigma * sqrt(T) (width = half a standard deviation).
rules.payout_at_expiry: min(max(K1 - S_T, 0), K1 - K2), cash settled on the close.
rules.costs: 2 SPX index points per spread (1 per leg, entry only; held to cash-settled expiry). Sensitivity: 4 points.
rules.no_filters: No VIX filter, no stop, no early exit, no sizing rule. One change per experiment.

baselines: buying the identical spread (the old project's side: pays credit + costs, receives payout)
SPX points change over the same cycles (context only)
metrics: cycles, win rate, mean net points per spread, total, worst cycle, max drawdown of cumulative net, mean net as % of max risk (width - credit), bootstrap 95% CI of mean (2000 draws, seed 1601).

verdict_at_cost_2.SUCCESS: mean net > 0 in every block AND full-period bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

scope_limit: Even SUCCESS only permits a paper test with real IBKR quotes (no orders). It is not evidence of real fills, skew, early-assignment-free execution, or margin outcomes.
